extension.summary: Kodi add-on for PhotoPrism: browse albums, photos and videos
extension.description: Kodi add-on for PhotoPrism. Browse the albums, timeline, photos and videos of your own PhotoPrism server, search albums, search with PhotoPrism query syntax, run slideshows (newest, oldest or random first) and play videos, with on-disk caching. Not affiliated with or endorsed by PhotoPrism.
extension.news: 1.2.0: Italian translation, pan/zoom switched off during slideshows (restored afterwards), Recently added / Random photos / On this day, Slideshow from here, hide empty albums, first-run guide. See CHANGELOG.md.
